source_findings: ThreadStartParams explicitly says an empty environments array disables environment access; P0 selected it, while the observed working v12 launch omitted it.

EnvironmentManager reserves local for its local executor; provider-supplied remote transports may not use that ID. Default discovery reads CODEX_HOME/environments.toml when present, otherwise environment variables.
The P0 process environment is an explicit minimal map that does not include exec-server/noise routing variables; bind the absent environments.toml condition before any revised startup.
A revised packet can select exactly environmentId local with fixture cwd/runtime roots, after status/info metadata checks; actual command/callback/native fork behavior still requires proof.
